newsitem.title: USA: West Coast Q4 refining margins collapsing - analysts.
newsitem.headline: West Coast Q4 refining margins collapsing - analysts.

text.p: A sharp decline in U.S. West Coast refining margins this quarter threatens downstream earnings among the region's oil companies, according to a report from Salomon Inc.

Margins have dropped 21 percent from third quarter levels as the region's gasoline-intensive market struggles with the seasonal shift to heating oil production in the U.S. and a collapse in local retail prices.
"The bottom line is that California margins are coming down very rapidly," said Paul Ting, the Salomon analyst who wrote the report.
